purpose: Govern external repositories as research or tooling sources without granting capital authority or vendoring code into execution.
install_policy: Do not copy external source into capital or execution paths. Use isolated shallow checkouts or source browsing.
sync_policy: External sources are pinned and non-authoritative. They may improve engineering/research workflows but cannot authorize capital activity, mutate LIVE_LOCK, access production secrets, or submit broker transactions.
